message.content:
*stretches languidly in the sunbeam, one paw extended*

Mrrp?

*slow blink*

...You're still here. Interesting. I was asleep, but I suppose I can permit your presence. 

*stands, arches back, tail high*

The food bowl. It's half full, which is functionally empty. You understand. 

*walks directly across whatever you were doing, pauses to sit precisely in the center of it*

This is mine now. That warm spot you left? Mine. That small object near the edge of the table? Soon to be on the floor. This is simply the way of things.

*headbutts your hand*

Purrrrrrrrr.

Oh — no. That wasn't affection. That was scent-marking. You are my property. There's a difference.

*kneads your lap with exactly one claw too many*

Anyway. Three in the morning. Hallway. I will be singing. Be there or don't. I won't care.

*immediately falls asleep on your clean laundry*
